senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced.) single grapes, esp. pereṭ, grapes fallen off during cutting, poor man’s share (Lev. XIX, 10). Sifra K’dosh., Par. 1, ch. III; Peah VII, 3 איזהו פ׳ הנושר וכ׳ pereṭ is that which drops &c.
units: Ib. VI, 5 שני גרגרים פ׳ וכ׳ two berries fallen at a time are pereṭ (belong to the poor), three are not pereṭ (may be picked up by the owner); a. fr.
